title: Duke's aversion to the color brown
summary: Willard asks if Duke's dislike of brown came from his mother's death; Bigard never heard that and says Duke did not trust him or fool with him.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Do you know if it's true that the reason he hated brown so much in later years, the color brown, was because he was wearing a brown suit the day his mother died? I've heard that story. You know if it's true?
No, I don't. I've never heard nothing like that.

He had (unintelligible) very strong feelings against the colors brown, yellow, and green. He didn't like them. And somebody told me that brown was because that's what he was wearing the day his mother died.
Oh, that's a story, because he had some brown clothes.
I don't know about the later years.

In later years everything was blue or variations of blue, red, purple, white, black. But no brown, no green, no yellow. And he didn't want anyone to wear those colors around him and he would tell them so. He would order them to change their clothes if they came around in those colors. But he didn't have those prejudices back when you were with him?
No. He wouldn't fool with me no-how. He didn't trust me.
